about_the_game:
MegaRacer QuantumRush - The Ultimate Open World Racing Experience

MegaRacer QuantumRush is an immersive open-world kart racing game that sets a new standard for racing experiences. Set in the sprawling futuristic city of Mega City, players can enjoy a variety of game modes while driving unique karts and controlling animated, cartoon-style characters. Designed for players of all ages, the game offers rich content that satisfies both beginners and seasoned racers.

Diverse Game Modes

MegaRacer QuantumRush delivers more than just traditional racing. Experience endless fun with a wide range of modes, including.

  • Street Racing: Speed through the city streets of Mega City in high-intensity races that test your reflexes and precision.

  • Obstacle Racing: Overcome complex barriers and traps in this strategic racing mode where careful planning leads to victory.

  • Crown Battle: Capture the crown within the time limit and hold onto it until the end to win.

  • Soccer Mode: An inventive mode that fuses racing with soccer—use your kart to drive the ball and score goals with your team.

  • Other Single and Multiplayer Modes: Explore Mega City to discover over 10 unique game modes and special events awaiting your challenge.

Explore Mega City and discover over ten unique modes and special events waiting to be challenged.

Immersion in VR with the Comfort of PC

Playable on both PC and VR platforms, MegaRacer QuantumRush is designed for comfortable, extended play sessions.

  • Advanced Visual Processing: Our specially designed VR camera and gameplay systems minimize motion sickness, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience.

  • Flexible Controls: Choose between immersive steering wheel-based VR control or relaxed gameplay using joysticks or keyboards.

  • Dual Input Support: Whether you prefer keyboard, mouse, gamepad, or VR controllers, all input types are fully supported and switch seamlessly depending on your setup.

Even without VR, the game offers a fully satisfying experience with smooth controls and dynamic visuals on standard PC environments.

Kart and Character Customization

In MegaRacer QuantumRush, players can freely customize their karts and characters.

  • Kart Customization: Choose your favorite colors, parts, and design elements to create a kart that reflects your personality.

  • Character Styling: Equip adorable characters with various outfits and gear to express your unique flair.

A Racing Experience for Everyone

MegaRacer QuantumRush is built to be accessible and fun for everyone—from casual beginners to racing veterans.

  • Variety of Races: Compete in lively multiplayer races or enjoy solo mini-games. Explore every corner of Mega City to discover hidden items and secrets.

Ongoing Updates with the Community

MegaRacer QuantumRush will continue to evolve through close communication with the community.

  • Regular content updates will introduce new tracks, modes, and customization options.

  • Beta tests and surveys will gather feedback to shape a better and more engaging game environment.

Start Your Race in the World of Mega City!

Chase the dream of becoming the ultimate racer in a world of speed and strategy. Race through the streets of Mega City, conquer unique challenges, and define your own racing style. MegaRacer QuantumRush offers a new level of casual racing fun that anyone can enjoy—regardless of platform.

name: MEGARACER QUANTUMRUSH

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 Ti
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Oculus Touch or better (Quest 2,3 only)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060
  • Storage: 32 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or Oculus PC. Standing or Room Scale

short_description: Experience thrilling VR racing in the vast futuristic city of Mega City. Customize unique vehicles and characters to enjoy your own racing style. Race toward victory with friends and players from around the world in serious yet fun competitions.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese
